title: CPU vs GPU vs NPU: What Does an AI Chip Do?
headline:
What is the
AI chip actually doing?
meaning: An NPU specializes in neural-network workloads.
example: Run supported AI operations efficiently on the device.
comparison: CPU, GPU and NPU handle different workloads.
caution: App support and the full system matter, too.
question: Which chip does your app actually use?
lines: An A I chip is not a tiny person inside your laptop. It is hardware designed for particular calculations.
A C P U handles general computing. A G P U processes many operations in parallel.
An N P U specializes in neural network workloads, helping supported A I tasks run efficiently on a device.
These processors work together. An app may use one or several depending on the operation.
A bigger marketing number alone does not tell you the whole experience. Software support and memory matter too.
